entries.statement: Every cost assertion declares basis, period and currency.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Quoted price, invoice amount, recognized cost, usage, allocated cost and valuation are separately typed and never substituted.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: A model identifier is never substituted for an object identifier, and object-level citation does not depend on registry allocation.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Every allocation run pins exactly one immutable rule revision.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: A run has exactly one allocation axis and exactly one currency.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Effective intervals of revisions of one rule are pairwise non-overlapping.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Allocation axis is identity-fixing for a rule; an axis change creates a new rule identity.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Within one run, the sum of target amounts and residual amounts equals sourceAmount within amountTolerance.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Target weights sum to one within weightTolerance over the allocable base; residual share is represented separately.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Every residual carries a closed residualKind and every rounding remainder is materialized.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: sourceAmountBasis is declared and ordered sourceAmountDerivation entries sum to sourceAmount.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Allocation base kind, source and completeness are explicit; partial completeness implies a non-zero residual.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Untagged usage remains residual and no implicit default target is permitted.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Parallel axes over intersecting source records are non-additive.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: The allocation-run chain is acyclic and a chained run conserves to its cited upstream results, each of which has at most one downstream consumer.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Unused reserved capacity uses exactly one closed treatment: shared-pool-result, separate-chained-run or residual-unused-capacity.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Discount treatment is pinned on the rule revision, allowance identity is retained, and gross and net views are reproducible.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Allocation occurs in source currency; translated results carry rate metadata and never enter conservation or unit-cost calculations.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Allocated cost is never a ledger posting without a separately authorized journal entry.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: An allocation result never mutates an invoice or journal master.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Runs and results are immutable; corrections append backward-linked successors with a reason and predecessors remain resolvable.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Confidence remains decomposed into measurement uncertainty, representativeness, commitment-coverage certainty and residual share.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Unit cost pins numerator basis, allocation run, denominator quantity source, metric-definition version, denominator completeness and residual treatment.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile

entries.statement: Retired rule, run and result identifiers remain resolvable and are never recycled.
entries.scope: EM-FIN-05 Cost Allocation cluster and source/unit-cost profile
